references.text: The Lord's warning to scatter Israel among the nations as punishment for disobedience, a prophecy repeated in Deuteronomy.
The same warning about being scattered among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other, as a consequence of breaking the covenant.
Nehemiah refers to this prophecy when he prays for Israel's restoration after the exile.
Ezekiel describes how a small remnant will remain among the nations, fulfilling this prophecy.
The Lord will scatter them among the nations and disperse them across the lands.
Hosea prophesies that Israel will become wanderers among the nations because of their sin.
Zechariah describes the scattering among all peoples whom they did not know.
Stephen quotes the prophecy about Israel's exile to Babylon in his speech.
